description: This file defines test fixtures for in-memory transaction testing in Orleans. It includes classes for configuring test clusters and custom configurators for memory-based transaction fixtures, extending a base test class.

classes.name: MemoryTransactionsFixture
classes.description: A test fixture class configuring an Orleans test cluster with in-memory transaction storage and services.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to add transaction-related services and storage.

classes.name: SkewedClockMemoryTransactionsFixture
classes.description: An extension of MemoryTransactionsFixture that adds a skewed clock configurator.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides base method to configure the test cluster builder for the fixture.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder with transaction services and memory storage.
